title: Happy unicorn
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>

    <polygon points='50,8 44,26 56,26' fill='#ffe066' stroke='#ffd21f' stroke-width='1.5'/>

    <path d='M42 24 Q38 14 46 20 Z' fill='#ffd1f0' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <path d='M58 24 Q62 14 54 20 Z' fill='#ffd1f0' stroke='#ff9be0' stroke-width='1'/>

    <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#fff4fb'/>

    <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M46 47 Q50 50 54 47' fill='none' stroke='#c0407f' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <circle cx='37' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff9bcb'/>
    <circle cx='63' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#ff9bcb'/>
    <!-- neck & body -->
    <path d='M42 47 Q40 58 34 66 Q50 74 66 66 Q60 58 58 47 Z' fill='#fff4fb'/>

    <rect x='66' y='70' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#fff4fb' stroke='#ffd1f0' stroke-width='1'/>

    <rect x='45' y='86' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8a2ff'/>

    <rect x='66' y='86' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c8a2ff'/>
